description.value: Your penchant for understanding other beings and gathering information allows you to quickly assess anyone before you. You can cast the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Analyze Target] cantrip as an occult innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. Once per day, as part of Casting the Spell, you can attempt a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Recall Knowledge] check as a free action on the target, or a single creature among the targets if you cast it on multiple creatures.
